subject: Error in twitteR package deployment on shinyapps.io

messages.author: aa2fac2cb2b554d6
messages.subject: Error in twitteR package deployment on shinyapps.io
parts:
I'm developing a sentiment analysis engine on shiny and R. The app runs perfectly on the local host but gives me an error when I try to deploy it on shinyapps.io. Attached is the image of the error on shinyapps.io
The error is

ERROR: there is no package called "twitteR"

Please do help me out :)

Thanks :)

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error in twitteR package deployment on shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi,

We had an issue with some of our packages that I think is now resolved:

Please update the following packages and try again:

devtools::install_github('rstudio/packrat')
devtools::install_github('rstudio/rsconnect')
devtools::install_github('rstudio/shinyapps')

-Andy

The error is

Please do help me out :)

Thanks :)

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error in twitteR package deployment on shinyapps.io
